title: Create the Gapminder dataset
text:
# Import necessary libraries
import pandas as pd
from gapminder import gapminder

# Rename 'lifeExp' to 'life_expectancy' and 'gdpPercap' to 'gdp_per_capita'
gapminder = gapminder.rename(columns={'lifeExp': 'life_expectancy',
                                      'pop': 'population_millions', 
                                      'gdpPercap': 'gdp_per_capita'})

# Convert population to millions
gapminder['population_millions'] = gapminder['population_millions'] / 1_000_000

# Create a new pandas DataFrame from the modified gapminder data
gapminder_df = pd.DataFrame(gapminder)

# Save the DataFrame as a CSV file
gapminder_df.to_csv('gapminder.csv', index=False)

# Print the first 3 rows of the DataFrame
print(gapminder_df.head(3))

title: Life Expectancy and GDP per Capita
text:
This page analyzes how life expectancy relates to GDP per capita over time using the Gapminder dataset.

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

fig = px.scatter(
    df,
    x="gdp_per_capita",
    y="life_expectancy",
    color="continent",
    hover_name="country",
    animation_frame="year",
    log_x=True,
    labels={
        "gdp_per_capita": "GDP per Capita (log scale)",
        "life_expectancy": "Life Expectancy (years)"
    },
    title="Life Expectancy vs GDP per Capita Over Time"
)
fig.show()

title: Country Analysis
text:
This page analyzes changes in life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population over time for one country.

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

country_name = "China"
d = df[df["country"] == country_name].sort_values("year")

d_long = d.melt(
    id_vars=["year"],
    value_vars=["life_expectancy", "gdp_per_capita", "population_millions"],
    var_name="metric",
    value_name="value"
)

pretty = {
    "life_expectancy": "Life Expectancy",
    "gdp_per_capita": "GDP per Capita",
    "population_millions": "Population (millions)"
}
d_long["metric"] = d_long["metric"].map(pretty)

fig = px.line(
    d_long,
    x="year",
    y="value",
    color="metric",
    markers=True,
    title=f"{country_name}: Trends Over Time",
    labels={"year": "Year", "value": "Value", "metric": "Metric"}
)
fig.show()

title: Life Expectancy and Population
